summary: Menu as of 2026-11-24: 47 candidates. No learning.json lesson names the Fundamentals Analyst and graded_calls holds none of my calls, so nothing from the record shaped today's ranking. L3, the PM's and Proposer's lesson on sector labels, agrees with my label flags below. My top names are the cleanest high-percentile, cash-backed scores: VRSN (F9, 0.993), CARG (F8, 1.0), DPZ (F8, 1.0, though its rank is a label artifact) and FTDR (F9, 0.954). Every held equity (DPZ, CARG, VRSN, IDXX, INCY, KR, SAM, MSCI) is still on the menu. TLT, an ETF, is the only holding off it. The main accounting concerns are DORM's earnings running well ahead of its cash flow, amended filings at GRMN and ONC, and stale fiscal years at CLX and BLBD.
